capabilities: Sort and filter Markdown table columns via the command palette
Validate and batch-edit YAML frontmatter with a JSON property viewer
Export notes to clean Markdown or standalone HTML with embedded images
Find and replace text within a note or across files with regex support
Insert footnotes and callouts, view JSON files, and show word count and reading progress
disambiguation: Not a UI or appearance enhancer; it is a bundle of editing commands, views, and export tools toggled per module in settings.
extras: The manifest carries the warning 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' Supports English and Simplified Chinese, desktop and mobile, and requires Obsidian 0.15.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian lacks many small editing conveniences, and getting them normally means installing and configuring many separate single-purpose plugins.
summary: Toolkit plugin bundling editing helpers: table sorting, YAML validation, export, find-and-replace, JSON viewing, word count, footnotes, callouts, and reading progress.
